title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region residency and augment audit logging
author: Priya Shah
release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency in RBAC v2 policy evaluation; Add richer KMS audit events including resolved_region and decision_reason; Migration to add tenant_kms_residency table; Backwards-compatible feature flag for staged rollout.
description: Motivation: enforce KMS region residency for RBAC v2 principals to meet customer data residency/compliance requirements and provide actionable audit trails for KMS usage. This PR implements server-side enforcement at policy evaluation time, persists tenant KMS residency preferences, and enhances audit events for KMS key selection/fallback. Changes are intentionally scoped to enforcement, audit telemetry, a small migration, and tests so we can ship safely. Related work: Linear ENG-7423, SEC-438; support ticket SUP-2199. Summary of changes: policy evaluator rejects uses of KMS keys outside the tenant-residency region unless tenant has an explicit allowlist; KMS client surfaces resolved_region and key_origin metadata; audit pipeline now emits kms_key_id, resolved_region, decision_reason, and policy_trace fields for every KMS-access decision; migration adds tenant_kms_residency table and backfills using existing tenant config; console docs and SDK surfaces updated to document residency behaviour and feature flag. Rollout plan: default enforcement enabled for new installs; existing customers will be migrated and rolled through a staged enablement (staging -> canary -> general) using feature flag rbac_v2.kms_residency.enforce (ops-controlled) to allow controlled opt-out during rollout. Testing: unit tests for policy evaluator and KMS client, integration tests against local KMS stub, manual smoke tests in staging (us-west2), and post-deploy log validation. CI history: initial lint error on audit schema fixed in follow-up commit, full test suite passed on rerun. Backwards compatibility: if tenant has no residency requirement we preserve current behavior; feature flag allows temporary opt-out while we backfill. Security review: addressed reviewer comments about exposing key material in logs (we only emit key_id and region, not key material) and added stricter redact rules. Ops: compose rollout checklist and monitoring dashboards (audit count by reason, policy rejections over time). Merge notes: merged after two approvals and green CI. See also PRs #110246 and #112500 for prior RBAC v2 residency work.
